Amy is interested in drawing. Ben thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the shopping mall by bike. For example, the total comes to fifty yuan.
Ben borrowed a book about history from the library. Ben usually has bread for breakfast. Ben's favorite animal is the rabbit. In fact, I cook breakfast on Sundays.
There are always many people at the fruit shop. The shopping mall is one of the best places in the city. Ben and Amy had great fun there. I paid for the meal by card.
Life is full of small surprises. Both of them like bread and juice. They took many photos at the fruit shop.
